name: dsh-neovim
description: Neovim bridge for DeepSeek Harness: remote vim command / Lua execution / Lua expression evaluation over the Neovim RPC socket, plus a full nvim-dap debugging toolset (start/step/breakpoints/watches/sessions) with paused/terminated/exited event injection back into the agent conversation, and automatic Neovim file reload when the agent writes a file.
